name: Weather Mix
description: A mood playlist for the weather, from the songs on the connected phone: Rainy Day Records, Sunny Tunes, Night Drive... It changes with the weather, the time of day and the season.

autoplay.label: Play it when the jukebox has been quiet for
autoplay.help: Only when a phone is connected and nothing is queued; once, until music has played again.

lastfm-key.label: Last.fm API key
lastfm-key.help: Finds the songs that fit the mood. Without one, the mix goes by your songs' genres. Get one at last.fm/api.

blocks.label: Weather Mix
blocks.description: A playlist for today's weather, with a headline that says what's in it. A bar across a row, a card in a narrow space; it can also be one of a Browse row's cards.

show-weather.label: Show the weather
show-weather.help: The temperature and sky beside the mix's name. Off: just the music.
